# Session log fixtures

These minimal fixtures use the redacted structured record shapes documented
for Codex 0.155.1 / 0.162.1 and Claude Code 2.1.280 / 2.1.296. IDs and timestamps
are neutral replacements; prose is redacted. They are format examples, not
copied user sessions. The 2025 envelope-free Codex example is unsupported.

Additional tests construct code variants, recovered errors, malformed tails,
span boundaries and size bounds. No test reads a real agent home or credentials.
